literal_meaning: সুতো বা কাপড়ে ছোট গিঁট বা আটকে যাওয়া
figurative_meaning_en: a minor flaw or slight mistake
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার পরিকল্পনায় একটি ছোট খিঁচ ছিল।
example_sentences_in_english: There's a snag in the work.
There was a small hitch in his plan.
note: Refers to a literal snag in fabric or thread, metaphorically extended to minor errors in Bengali vernacular.
